summary: Pick representatives C of the S-orbits of the image of D in G_f/J; T = (S ∩ A)·C is finite. The multiplicity at xJ is the index of Stab_S(xJ) ∩ A in Stab_S(xJ), which divides a power of q because conjugates of J by x are q-power torsion modulo A.

steps.claim: Choose C ⊆ the image of D in G_f/J meeting every S-orbit of that image exactly once (hC: C lies in the image; i: C meets each orbit at most once; u: every orbit is met).
steps.lean:
((mk '' D).exists_subset_bijOn (orbit S)).elim fun C ⟨hC, _,
  i, u⟩ ↦

steps.claim: The set T₀ = {t : p⁻¹t ∈ C for some p ∈ S ∩ A} is finite: it lies in the image of A·D in G_f/J, which is finite because A·D is compact and J is open. Take the finset T with t ∈ T ⟺ t ∈ T₀ (m).
steps.lean:
(Finite.exists_finset (s := {t | ∃ p : S, ↑p ∈ A ∧ p⁻¹ • t ∈ C})
  ((finite_quotient_image_of_isCompact o.2 (k.isCompact.mul cD)).subset fun t ⟨p, h,
  a⟩ ↦ (hC a).elim fun d e ↦ ⟨_, ⟨p, h, d, e.1, rfl⟩, eq_inv_smul_iff.1 e.2⟩)).imp fun T m ↦ by

steps.claim: Replace membership in T by its description m.

(i) T is stable under S ∩ A: reindex the witness p by p·. (ii) If xJ ∈ T, then p⁻¹xJ = dJ with d ∈ D, p ∈ S ∩ A; since p ∈ A ⊆ B, d ∈ B (hD) and J ≤ A ≤ B, x ∈ B. It remains (iii) for y with yJ ∈ T or W(y).
steps.lean:
use fun p _ _ ↦ (toPerm p).exists_congr (by simp_all [mul_mem_cancel_left, mul_smul]), fun x
    ⟨r, hr, h⟩ ↦ (hC h).elim fun d ⟨h, e⟩ ↦ by
    simpa [mul_mem_cancel_left, b hr, *] using b (l (QuotientGroup.eq.1 e)), fun y h ↦ ?_

steps.claim: In both cases yJ is in the S-orbit of an element of C: if yJ ∈ T this is the definition; if W(y), r·y ∈ D for some r ∈ S (hW), and the orbit of r·yJ is met by C (u).
steps.lean:
let ⟨_, ht, e⟩ := h.elim (fun ⟨r, h⟩ ↦ ⟨_, h.2, by simp⟩)
    (hW y · |>.elim fun r h ↦ u ⟨_, ⟨_, h.2, rfl⟩, orbit_smul (⟨r, h.1⟩ : S) (mk y)⟩)

steps.claim: Write yJ = r·xJ with r ∈ S and xJ ∈ C, x ∈ D (hx).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨r, e⟩, x, hx, rfl⟩ := orbit_eq_iff.1 e.symm, hC ht

steps.lean:

    x)).relIndex_ne_zero (K := MulAut.conj x • A) k.2) ∘ relIndex_eq_zero_of_le_right
    (K := stabilizer S (mk x)) fun r h ↦ ⟨_, l (QuotientGroup.eq.1 h.symm), by simp⟩)

steps.claim: By S-invariance (coverMultiplicity_smul), coverMultiplicity(yJ) = coverMultiplicity(xJ), the number of cosets of S ∩ A met by {r ∈ S : r⁻¹xJ ∈ T}. This set is the orbit of the identity coset under the stabiliser of xJ (one inclusion because C meets each orbit once, the other directly), so coverMultiplicity(xJ) is the index of the stabiliser of the coset of A in Stab_S(xJ).
